protocolDependency: V10 signed limit orders and atomic settlement
invariants: order review preserves maker, sell token, buy token, total sell amount, minimum total net buy amount, recipient, primary market, nonce, expiry and partial-fill policy
partial-fill minimum buy requirements preserve the signed full-order ratio and round upward
non-partial orders cannot be partially filled
filled sell amount cannot exceed signed sell amount
open, partial, filled, cancelled and expired states are deterministic
cancellation remains fail closed until wallet/session integration is available
history preserves order hash and transaction provenance
demo order records are explicitly labeled and cannot be mistaken for live canonical orders
follow_on: V14.8 bridge and cross-chain settlement UI
